subject.title: feat(session): add chat-channel session switching with LRU history retention

question: Should OpenClaw standardize chat-session recovery around this PR's `/sessions <target>` design, the competing `/resume` design, or a narrower canonical implementation under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/86829?
rationale: The remaining choice is not only code repair: `/sessions`, `/resume`, existing `/session`, `/focus`, native chat menus, and security-sensitive session-boundary restore semantics overlap and need maintainer intent before a branch should be adopted.

options.title: Settle the canonical design first
options.body: Keep this PR open but paused behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/86829 until maintainers choose the command/API shape and session-boundary contract.

options.title: Repair and adopt this branch
options.body: Require the contributor or a maintainer to rebase, fix the source-backed blockers, and add inspectable real chat proof before reconsidering merge.

options.title: Prefer the competing `/resume` lane
options.body: If maintainers prefer the `/resume` UX, close this PR only after a proof-positive replacement is accepted or merged so contributor work is not discarded prematurely.

recommendation.title: Settle the canonical design first
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but paused behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/86829 until maintainers choose the command/API shape and session-boundary contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history shows repeated adjacent work on session controls and command surfaces, and this decision is mainly command shape plus session-state product direction.
